title: SLA breached badges: verify rules/timestamps first — breaches may be legitimate; fix only if calculation, first-response tracking, reassignment handling, sweep, or UI mapping is wrong

root_cause_analysis.enum_mismatch: index.html and app.js used 'sla_on_time' and 'sla_approaching' while database migration 022 and api.js required 'on_time' and 'approaching_sla'. Unresponded on-time deals rendered no badge, and filtering by 'On Time' or 'Approaching' resulted in HTTP 400 rejection.
root_cause_analysis.first_response_tracking: database.js logMessage checked isHuman via typeof arg2 === 'object', failing for shorthand logMessage(userId, phone, 'outgoing', text) calls and never recording first_response_at, while also running recordFirstResponse unawaited.
root_cause_analysis.reassignment_corruption: lead-assignment.js assignLead unconditionally reset sla_status to 'on_time' and sla_response_due_at to first_response_at on deals that had already been responded to.
root_cause_analysis.sweep_transition: checkAndEscalateOverdueSlas only processed overdue leads, omitting proactive transition of leads nearing their deadline (within 15 minutes) to 'approaching_sla'.
